unit: The student can welcome a guest, introduce someone, make basic small talk, and politely offer a drink.
objective: Greet a guest appropriately upon arrival.

title: Warm up
subtitle: Welcoming a guest
question: When a guest arrives at your home or office, what is the first thing you say?

title: Useful Language (Part 1)
teacher_instructions: Read each word aloud and ask the student to repeat.
Read the definition and example sentence.
Ask the check question to confirm understanding.
Ask the student to make their own sentence using one of the words.

words.definition: A word we use to greet someone when we see or meet them.
words.check: Do you say 'hello' when you meet someone or when you leave?

words.definition: A polite word we use when a guest arrives at our home or office.
words.check: Do you say 'welcome' when a guest arrives or when they leave?

title: Useful Language (Part 2)
teacher_instructions: Read each word aloud and ask the student to repeat.
Read the definition and example sentence.
Ask the check question to confirm understanding.
Ask the student to make their own sentence using one of the words.

words.check: Which of these is a name: Ali or hello?

words.definition: To see and speak to someone for the first time.
words.check: When do you say 'nice to meet you': when you say hello, or when you say goodbye?

title: Conversation Builder
goal: Learn how to greet a guest at the door.

linkers.use: Use this to greet a guest when they arrive.
Use this to be polite after someone introduces themselves.

model:
Guest: Hi there!
Host: Hello, welcome. My name is Alex.
Guest: Thanks! I'm Sam.
Host: Nice to meet you, Sam.

your_turn.teacher: Pretend to knock on the door and say hello.
your_turn.student: Pretend to open the door, welcome the teacher, and introduce yourself.

title: Let's practice
teacher_question: Imagine I'm a guest visiting your home and I'm standing at your door. Say hello, tell me your name, and welcome me. Use the sentences below to practice.
student_guide: Oh, hello! Welcome! My name is ___.

title: Real-World Scenario
role_a: You are the host. You open the door.
role_b: You are the guest. You arrive and knock on the door.
problem: A guest has arrived at your home. Greet them and introduce yourself.
mission: Say hello and welcome the guest.

title: Wrap-up
recap: Chunks: Hello, welcome. / Nice to meet you. / My name is...
Skill: Greet a guest appropriately upon arrival.
final_task: Use one of today's chunks to respond to this greeting: 'Hello, I am your new tutor.'
challenge: Practice greeting someone in English today.
